Balanced-ternary digit weight obeys precisely the simplified recurrences and the necessary 1-Lipschitz inequality. Strong induction on window length proves both extrema; a one-step window shift fills all Parikh counts. The supplied actual standalone verifier passed 1794 phase algebra instances, 100000 digit instances and 8960 direct window checks; these are supplemental finite diagnostics. No infinite step relies solely on computation.
